correctness.rationale: PASS: Tridiagonal uniform-hat Gram matrix gives alternating inverse endpoint row (-1)^j a_j with positive decreasing a_j, and r1=1/2, r_(n+1)=1/(4-r_n). Every bounded monotone f is a mixture of right-step functions plus constant. For endpoint kernel K the step response E(s)=integral_s^n K has first-cell minimum -delta_n at s=1/(1+r_n), delta_n=3/((2-r_n)(1+r_n))-1. Alternating-series bounds at later cell boundaries and their only internal critical points prove -delta_n<=E<=1 globally, treating n=1,2 separately; reflection gives right endpoint. The recurrence decreases to 2-sqrt3 and the defect increases strictly to (sqrt3-1)/2. Independent exact rational Gram inversion and every cell critical value n=1..30 reproduced the bound and the listed first three fractions (C4_OK).
